# Michael T. Wolfinger — full-text companion to https://michaelwolfinger.com/llms.txt

Independent Principal Investigator in computational RNA biology, Vienna, Austria. Research on RNA secondary structure, folding kinetics, functional RNA design, RNA-protein recognition, and structured viral RNAs. Independent research is conducted through RNA Forecast (https://rnaforecast.com).
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0925-5205 · Contact: michael.wolfinger@rnaforecast.com
Site: https://michaelwolfinger.com/ · Blog feed: https://michaelwolfinger.com/feeds/all.atom.xml
